name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: 🐝 Long hives are drawn from above now, the way you see them with the lid off. "I stand at the Front | Back" under the drawing turns it round if you work from the back.

🪵 Boards inside the hive: follower boards (one each side for a colony in the middle) and a red solid divider for two colonies in one box, each its own hive. A board sits at its own frame, like "at 20, between 19 and 21".
🚪 Entrances: what kind (bottom slot, round hole, upper slot) and what's on it (mouse guard, robbing screen, entrance disc). Reduced ones show an R. Say "put the mouse guards on".
🍯 Top bar hives get the same: bars, boards, entrances and the drawing, plus cross comb, comb attached and new comb.
🟧 "Pollen and honey band" is now "frames of pollen".
